Drawn 1085-1091 only; Dénia then goes to the Almoravids ('1092-1224') and the Lérida page has Sulayman's regents 'separating Denia and Tortosa to their own advantage' after 1090.

correction.text: Tortosa and its district under Sulayman Sayyid

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, 1092-1098: the Tortosa core without the Dénia lands, which the Dénia page gives to the Almoravids from 1092. Cliopatria keeps the larger shape to 1098; its own 1099 shape is reused.

5,713 km2 for 1099-1110: the Tortosa core. The page ends the taifa in 1099 ('from 1081 to 1099'; 'Conquered by Granada: 1099' in the infobox, which the Taifa overview does not echo), though its ruler list has Sulayman Sayyid to c. 1115 and 'To Morocco: c. 1115-1148'. Drawn for 1099 only as the taifa; the land is Almoravid from 1100 until the conquest of 1148. The overview ends the taifa in 1092 (to Dénia).

ledger.note: 1010: Tortosa breaks away from the Caliphate of Córdoba. 'It existed for two separate periods, from 1010 to 1060 and 1081 to 1099'; founded by 'the Slavic warlord Labib al-Fata al-Saqlabi' (list: c. 1009). The page names the city only; the district is Cliopatria's.

1060: Zaragoza annexes Tortosa. Infobox 'To Zaragoza: 1060-1081 (or 2/3)'; 'from 1010 to 1060'. The Lérida page says al-Muqtadir 'acquired the taifa of Tortosa in 1061', so 1060 is the Tortosa page's year.

1081: Tortosa is independent again under al-Mundhir. 'from 1081 to 1099'; list 'Imad al-Dawla Mundhir: 1081 or 1082/3 - 1090' after the division of the Zaragoza taifa at al-Muqtadir's death in late 1081 (Lérida page, which also has al-Mundhir 'already governing Denia and Tortosa as his father's hajib').

region.text: the Dénia lands held with Tortosa 1081-1092

ledger.note: 1081: the Dénia lands pass to Tortosa. Dénia infobox 'To Zaragoza/Tortosa/Almoravids: 1076-1081 / 1081-1092 / 1092-1224'; the Lérida page: al-Mundhir governed Denia as well. Cliopatria's Tortosa shape holds 17 cells of the Dénia shape from 1085.

1092: the Dénia lands leave Tortosa. Infobox '1092-1224' for the Almoravids; the Lérida page has Sulayman's regents 'separating Denia and Tortosa to their own advantage' (undated, after al-Mundhir's death in 1090). Cliopatria keeps them in Tortosa's shape to 1098.

1099: the taifa ends. 'It existed for two separate periods, from 1010 to 1060 and 1081 to 1099'; infobox 'Succeeded by: Almoravid dynasty'. The page's list runs Sulayman Sayyid to c. 1115 and Cliopatria to 1110, so the year is the page's sentence over its own list; Tortosa fell to Ramon Berenguer IV in 1148.

wars.name: Annexation of Tortosa by Zaragoza
wars.outcome: Tortosa passed to Zaragoza in 1060 (the Lérida page: acquired by al-Muqtadir in 1061) and stayed until the division of 1081.

wars.name: Almoravid takeover of the Tortosa taifa
wars.outcome: The Dénia lands went to the Almoravids in 1092; the taifa of Tortosa ended in 1099 and was Almoravid until Ramon Berenguer IV took it in 1148.
wars.note: The Tortosa page gives only 'Conquered by Granada: 1099' and a succession to the Almoravids; no campaign is described.

certainty.note: No page opened gives a boundary line for Tortosa; its district on the lower Ebro and the Dénia lands of 1081-1092 are approximate.

notes:
IDENTITY. Two periods, 1010-1060 and 1081-1099, with Zaragoza between (Tortosa page). Start 1010 from the page's sentence (the ruler list has Labib c. 1009). The end is unsettled: the page's sentence says 1099 and its infobox 'Conquered by Granada: 1099' (probably an error for the Almoravids, who had absorbed Granada), its ruler list runs Sulayman Sayyid to c. 1115, Cliopatria to 1110, the Taifa overview ends it in 1092 'to Denia'; the dossier uses 1099. The Tortosa page states no area and names no territory, so no area comparison was possible and every keyframe rests on Cliopatria's cells.
CLIOPATRIA. Shapes 1010-1056 are kept (the page dates no change); 1056 is cut at 1060; 1085 (core + 17 Dénia cells) matches the Dénia infobox 'To Tortosa: 1081-1092' and is drawn to 1091; two new keyframes cover 1081-1084 and 1092-1098; 1099 is drawn to 1099 only (Cliopatria to 1110).
UNSETTLED. (1) 1060 (Tortosa page) against 1061 (Lérida page) for the Zaragoza annexation; the Zaragoza dossier uses 1060. (2) 1081 or 1082/3 for al-Mundhir; the Lérida page says the division came 'in late 1081'. (3) The 1099 'Granada' conquest and the real Almoravid takeover of Tortosa are not described on any page opened. (4) The Dénia lands of Tortosa 1081-1092 sit in Cliopatria's Tortosa row, not in the Dénia row; the Dénia dossier (another part) has Dénia's own events. (5) Barcelona's tribute relation: the Lérida page has Lleida paying tribute to Ramon Berenguer III under al-Mundhir and Sulayman; the Tortosa page says nothing about Barcelona, so none is written here. (6) The Tortosa page's succession 'To Morocco: c. 1115-1148' and the 1148 conquest (Tortosa page) are for the Almoravid and Barcelona dossiers.
PAGES. Taifa of Tortosa, Tortosa (city), Taifa of Dénia, Taifa of Lérida, Taifa (overview): five.
